_about: Boardwalk Arcade on the kiosk screen: one visit is limited so nobody camps while others wait. Edit, publish, done (the page re-reads this on every visit). Prize caps and odds are NOT here: the Worker and arcade-routes.js enforce those. A missing or bad file or value falls back to the built-in defaults, never to 'no limit'.
_serverKeys: maxPrizeRolls = prize chances per visit (slot spins + finished games share them; 1 = the first spin or finished game of a visit is the only one that can win, the pages say so after it); useOnSameVisit = a win becomes this kiosk's pending prize and the order-screen banner (false: the customer only gets the code / phone link for next time); gameMinSeconds = a game must have run this long on the server clock before its finish can roll; visitGapSeconds = quiet time that ends a visit (an open arcade page pings every 20 s, so keep it a little over 20; 25 to 900).
_gameKeys: gameMaxSeconds = the time cap for one visit to the games picker and the five games together (counts from the first game page, shared across games; 30 to 900 seconds). The slot machine has its own maxSpins/maxSeconds above. gameDifficulty = which tuning table the five games use: "arcade86" (harder, 1986 arcade pace) or "classic" (the original gentler numbers). Anything else, a missing key or an unreadable file means "classic". To flip it: edit this value, run tools/publish-manifest.js, push (content only, no restart); it applies from the next game page load, and a run never changes table once started.
